note: v3408: His ruling: Grok CLI secondary, Claude CLI primary, and no API because there is bouncing regardless. The trigger, measured the same hour: an API-key seat answered PERMISSION_DENIED used-all-available-credits mid-ship, while the pre-push gate was demanding a second-eye look - an API seat that bounces is an EMPTY SEAT, and an empty seat blocks a push while proving nothing. THE TREE WAS ALREADY RIGHT AND THAT IS WHY THIS EXISTS: zero of 198 shipped modules call a model API, so nothing needed repairing and what was missing is the LAW, because a correct state nothing pins is a state that drifts. The second half is safety rather than billing: a CLI eye is an AGENT with tools and pointed at this checkout it can EDIT IT, witnessed the same day with a Grok CLI session writing to tv while a ship was mid-flight. The eye now runs on a scratch cwd, and its bound moved 300s to 1200s because 300 was MEASURED too short - a 22,519-char payload ran past it and was filed an empty seat, blocking a ship for a look nobody waited for. 6 laws, 3 red-proofs PROVEN, plus a heart row that answers PER MACHINE because a box with no signed-in CLI files empty seats however healthy the fleet totals look.
